root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the bytes of `*lp` are initialized before `return FALSE`
root_cause_criterion.criterion: On the out-of-range `pc` path selected by `each_backtrace()`, `mrb_debug_get_position()` must initialize the caller-provided `*lp` output before returning `FALSE`, so the later `loc.lineno == -1` branch never consults uninitialized stack state.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the selected `return FALSE` with `lp_initialized_prefix_len < lp_bytes`, while the fixed original reaches the same protected branch site with the same `pc` argument but `*lp` fully initialized.

nodes.state: Immediately before `if (loc.lineno == -1)`, the selected branch still sees fewer initialized bytes in `loc.lineno` than the 4-byte read width on the vulnerable crashing path.

At the selected `idx = (uint32_t)(pc - irep->iseq)` computation, the derived debug-position index already lies outside `irep->ilen`, so the immediately following lookup call takes its failure return path.

edges.relation: The caller slot pointer `lp` left under-initialized by the selected `mrb_debug_get_position()` failure return is the same `&loc.lineno` field later branched on in `each_backtrace()`.
The out-of-range `idx` computed in `each_backtrace()` is passed unchanged as the `pc` argument to `mrb_debug_get_position()`, where it selects the failure return that leaves `*lp` uninitialized.
